title: Pet-Friendly Abode w/ Balcony in East Nashville!
description:
'The Culture Club' | Easy Access to I-40 & I-65 | 3 Mi to Nissan Stadium

Music, culture, and Southern hospitality — this vacation rental puts all the perks of Nashville right at your fingertips! With its walkable location and stylish interior, this 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath townhome is an ideal base for relaxation and exploration. Sip your coffee al fresco, then venture out to sample unique eats, watch a show at the Grand Ole Opry, and hit Broadway's famous honky-tonks. A memorable stay awaits!

The space
SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS
- Bedroom 1: 1 king bed
- Bedroom 2: 2 queen beds
- Bedroom 3: 2 full bunk beds
- Living Room: 1 full futon

MAIN FEATURES
- Balcony w/ dining area
- Smart TVs (bring your own streaming logins)
- Electric fireplace
- En-suite bathrooms, walk-in closets
- Dining table

KITCHEN
- Refrigerator, stove/oven, dishwasher
- Keurig coffee maker, blender, microwave
- Cooking basics, spices, dishware & flatware
- Trash bags/paper towels

GENERAL
- Central heating & A/C
- Washer/dryer, laundry detergent, iron/board
- Linens/towels, complimentary toiletries, hair dryer
- Free WiFi

FAQ
- Pet fee (paid pre-trip)
- 1 exterior security camera (facing out)

ACCESSIBILITY
- 3-story townhome, exterior stairs to enter
- 1 bedroom & 1 full bathroom on 1st floor
- Stairs to 2nd-floor kitchen & living room

PARKING
- Designated area (2 vehicles)
- Additional community parking lot (first-come, first-served)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

Other things to note
- No smoking
- Pet friendly w/ $50 fee (+ fees & taxes, 2 max)
- No pets allowed on the furniture
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Must be at least 18 years old to book
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- This 3-story townhome requires exterior stairs to enter. While it offers 1 bedroom and 1 full bathroom on the 1st floor, interior stairs are required to access the living room and kitchen on the 2nd floor
- Your safety matters. This property features 1 exterior security camera on the front door, facing the front outdoor entry. It does not look into any interior spaces. The camera records video and sound when activated by motion
